VOCR5-V.topology: train/model.py TinyVNOCR width 1.0, bottleneck 96, depth 1, ctx 2 (VOCR5-S's)
VOCR5-V.recipe: train/train2.py --steps 30000 --batch 96 --lr 0.001 --final-lr 0.05 --warmup 500 --wd 0.01 --width 1.0 --bottleneck 96 --vocab data/vocab_4987_proof.txt --ema 0.999 --threads 5 --eval-every 2500 --keep-evals --src vsyn:0.75:<the 100 pinned shards>:stream=1,pool=6,inv=0.2 --src vra:0.15:vreal_agree.npz:inv=0.2 --src vps:0.10:vreal_ps.npz:inv=0.2 --val vval:<pinned val shard>:n=3000 --select vval

data.synthetic: data/manifests/vertical_shards_v1.json (synth/vertical_render.py, 100 x 10,000 training crops + 3,000 validation crops)

real_agree.rule: training-side pages only (eval/vertical_data.py train-pages: no VN sharing a VNDB-relation component with a development or test VN, no reserved.json test or dev_sample VN, no test session, no eval screenshot); MeikiOCR's page read == PP-OCRv6 small's read of the turned crop; each also at half scale

real_ps.rule: the same pages; the two disagree, PP-OCRv6 small's lowest character confidence >= 0.9: its reading

VOCR5-V.model_of_a_run: its last checkpoint (step 30,000, the EMA weights); --select only picks ckpt_best for monitoring, which is not used
VOCR5-V.runs: seed 1 is the candidate; at most 3 more runs in all (seed 2 for its variance, report only; a smaller vocabulary only if seed 1 is adopted, under the same rule against it)
VOCR5-V.manga109s: added as a training source only if the owner's token appears; such a run is a new candidate under the same rule, and its release notes say Manga109-s

rules.code_only: a1 replaces a0 only if a1 - a0 on VN development (VOCR5-N) has an interval entirely below 0; R* = the better arm with VOCR5-N
rules.adopt_V: VOCR5-V (seed 1) is adopted when (i) VN development: V - R* has an interval upper bound below +0.5 points, and (ii) V's VN point estimate is lower than R*'s, or V - R* on manga development has an interval entirely below 0
rules.sizes: among adopted VOCR5-V sizes the smallest wins; if none is adopted, R* ships and VOCR5-V is reported as not adopted
rules.manga_never_trades_vn: manga is never a reason to accept a resolved VN loss
rules.finder: candidates: P0 = synth/vertical_twin.py variant 0 (GRAD transposed), P1 = variant 1 (valley split, density-gated growth), D = the textdet detector s8_c24 (v0.3.1-textdet.1, sha256 8a13dbddbc7d6305ccfaf8164ad1c4d9030437fde76eeedca68f24ac5cc47179) vertical boxes. With the selected recognizer arm: P1 replaces P0 only if P1 - P0 end-to-end VN development CER has an interval entirely below 0; D replaces the chosen projection finder only if D - it has an interval entirely below 0 and its arena (with the recognizer's) stays within the tier's; eligible finders: arena <= 131,072 B at 960x544, C == twin on every development region
rules.test: the test set is read once, after the selection is committed and pushed, for the selected finder and arm; every other arm is report only

estimates: console time is a host estimate: MAC counts of the recognizer at VOCR3-H15's measured 5.0-5.2 ms per CTC frame (1,564,992 MACs per frame), 333 and 444 MHz; nothing here has run on a console
